records.failureSummary: Implemented completion-toggle and delete for TaskBoard (frontend only), turning [AC-16], [AC-17] and [AC-18] green without editing the T-04 spec. Product changes: (1) src/components/TaskItem.vue now exposes the AC-named testids - the toggle button is data-testid="ta[REDACTED]" (was the invented "toggle-task-button") and the delete button is data-testid="ta[REDACTED]" (was "delete-task-button"); data-done still maps task.done to the literal "true"/"false". These names were confirmed against the T-04 spec by running it (it went from 3 red to 8/8 green). (2) src/App.vue toggle(): optimistic flip, then PATCH ${VITE_API_BASE}/api/tasks/:id with body {"done": !done}; on success the returned task replaces the entry via replaceTask (so data-done comes from the server response, order and task-count untouched) and pageError is cleared; on failure the previous done is rolled back and a message goes into pageError (reuses error-banner). The whole call is inside try/catch, so no unhandled rejection and no console.error. (3) src/App.vue remove(): optimistic removal of the id, DELETE ${VITE_API_BASE}/api/tasks/:id (204 handled in the api client before any JSON parse), task-count auto -1 because it is derived from tasks.length; on failure the pre-delete snapshot is restored and pageError is set, again inside try/catch. (4) Initial load keeps rendering data-done from the GET payload only - loadTasks writes the items as returned, with no local override. State coverage checked: loading/error/empty/success all still behave (banner only from pageError, empty-state from source length, list from visibleTasks). New tests (all marker-prefixed): src/App.toggle-delete.test.ts with [AC-16] x2 (PATCH path+body+data-done flip and flip-back; failing PATCH rolls back, shows error-banner, no unhandled rejection, console.error not called), [AC-17] x2 (real second GET after remount renders done=true; a GET that already reports done=true renders without any PATCH), [AC-18] x2 (DELETE path, row removed, task-count 3->2; failing DELETE restores the row, keeps count 3, rejects nothing). Verification: npm run test => 24 files / 145 tests passed (includes tests/fr3-fr4-list-ops.spec.ts 8/8 and tests/fr1-list.spec.ts, fr2, smoke); npm run lint exit 0; npm run typecheck exit 0; npm run build exit 0 (dist regenerated). Transparent note: the testid rename required updating the stale selector literals in three pre-existing test files (src/App.acceptance.test.ts, src/App.empty-state.test.ts, src/contract.test.ts whitelist) to the same AC names; only the selector/whitelist strings changed - no assertion was weakened, relaxed or deleted, and the T-04 spec file tests/fr3-fr4-list-ops.spec.ts was left untouched.
